title: El se en el discurso administrativo y legal
goal: Deploy the impersonal and reflexive 'se' in decrees, judicial rulings, minutes, and administrative edicts.
grammar: uso de la pasiva refleja e impersonal en registros jurídicos, administrativos y notariales

items: Formulate performative legal resolutions using 'se dispone', 'se resuelve', and 'se notifica'.
Confer formal institutional objectivity to executive decrees and official communiqués.
Structure solemn legislative clauses adhering to legal drafting house style.
